title: Insight lab: nothing strong this week
why: Saturday run, 21 Nov 2026: a fifth independent sample of 205 scored homepages. The biggest gap this week is mostly frame composition; the platform findings are either under 30 sites or already in the pending W44 cards.
body:
RESULT: no new content this week.

LARGEST GAP, NOT PUBLISHED (low):
Professional-services homepages scored 11.7 points below SaaS and agency homepages this week (95% interval 7.6 to 16.0; 69 vs 136 sites). Across five samples the gap is -0.3, -2.3, -7.6, -2.9 and -11.7: same direction every time, size set by the frame. Within WordPress it is 2.9 points pooled. The large gaps come from firms on platforms our detector does not recognize, likely older custom builds (a guess). This week's frame had the most non-WordPress firms of any sample. Under 5 points within a platform, so low under our rules.

STILL UNDER THE 30-SITE FLOOR (low):
llms.txt follows the builder: Wix 26 of 27 present, Squarespace 2 of 29, pooled over five samples. One targeted frame would settle it.

REPLICATION FOR THE PENDING W44 CARDS (medium as a fact):
Webflow fails Organization/WebSite schema on 42 of 82 homepages, WordPress on 27 of 485, pooled over five samples. Fifth replication; not a new post.

DISCARDED: Vercel sites blocking more (3 of 17); pillar correlation (schema checks sit in two pillars); crawler access as the biggest fix (admin-path Disallow rules); the top-5% profile (defined by passing everything); Bytespider and CCBot as most blocked (7 blockers, repeats the Launch Edition).

SCANNER NOTE: 4 professional-services homepages failed title and lang together, which looks like an interstitial page scored as real. Excluding them leaves a 9.4-point gap. Worth a check that treats such pages as failed fetches.

METHOD: 227 domains found by web search on 21 Nov 2026, not random, so likely more SEO-active than average; 205 scored, homepage only, one scan each, from a data-center address. No overlap with the four earlier frames. Readiness only.
